ComfyUI, after the dependencies are installed, start webui, and the webpage keeps showing loading.

ComfyUI, after the dependencies are installed, start webui, and the webpage keeps showing loading. There is no error. I always thought that it might be cuda or torch that is not installed properly, but the final reason is unexpected: my Google Chrome version is too old and cannot render the front-end code of webui. I just need to upgrade the browser.
